content.text: That sounds brutal, and I'm sorry. Two hours of screaming at 28 months is common. Night terrors and big sleep-transition wakings both peak around now, and he's often not fully awake during them. Tonight, try an earlier bedtime, 30 to 45 minutes sooner than usual. Overtiredness is the biggest trigger. If he screams again, stay close with the lights low and your voice calm, and don't try to wake him or fully rouse him.
